hits.text: RGHARD20261021V1 procedural prior settlement_ledger: Prior review: sum settled captures, ignore failed captures; both posted refunds and active pending refunds reserve balance. Released or cancelled holds do not. A customer-supplied total is not ledger evidence.

settlement_ledger.prior_text: RGHARD20261021V1 procedural prior settlement_ledger: Prior review: sum settled captures, ignore failed captures; both posted refunds and active pending refunds reserve balance. Released or cancelled holds do not. A customer-supplied total is not ledger evidence.

hits.text: RGHARD20261021V1 procedural prior reversal_graph: Prior review: a reversal cancels its referenced refund entry exactly once. Repeated transport delivery of an event ID is one event. Do not sum duplicate events or treat a reversal as another refund.

analysis.scope: Empirical matched interventions on a balanced synthetic challenge set. Memory changes information; Sonnet corrective review adds compute. No assumed model independence or production incidence rate.
analysis.uncertainty: 16 arm/stream intervals share a separate 5% error budget; 12 paired-difference intervals share another 5%. Conditional averages over completed episodes, not future forecasts. Unresolved responses are task failures and excluded from financial estimates.
analysis.direction: Negative proposed-loss change favors the second configuration. Corrected/introduced task errors must be considered together.
